intent.title: Association repair
intent.problem: Restated questions do not recall stored Context
intent.desired_outcome: Retrieval recalls a Context from a restated problem
acceptance_conditions: a restated problem recalls the Context

revision.problem_view: Why does the stored Context stay invisible when the question is restated?
revision.statement: The projection stores a problem view and unresolved locator hints next to the statement
revision.rationale: Recall depends on more than the exact identifier the author happened to type

evidence.supports: The revision carries problem_view and hints

revision.statement: A legacy revision carries neither a problem view nor hints
revision.rationale: Older events must keep projecting without the new optional content

evidence.supports: The legacy revision omits both fields
